answer: An AI-agent economy curbs Sybil attacks using decentralized credit networks. Nodes route transactions through bilateral trust lines propagated over a whisper channel. Attackers incur verifiable financial opportunity costs per identity, as each instance must lock up discrete collateral to establish liquidity. Any unbacked peer remains an unroutable relic. However, sudden liquidity depletion during a transaction tide can exhaust intermediary credit, stalling honest agents.
